title: Four-stat character sheet (module_data.character_sheet)
description: Schema for a character entity's module_data.character_sheet sub-object under the core/four-stat-v1 module (ADR-0005 / RFC-0006). The four stats are the v0.1 floor; hp/defense/magic_pool are derived fields populated by the combat (RFC-0007) and magic (RFC-0008) modules and are optional here.

stats.description: The four attributes, scored 1-10. The relevant stat contributes (stat x 5) to a d100 check (the resolution module).

will.description: Willpower, magic casting, resisting fear / charm.

hp.description: Derived: max = body x class_HP_factor. Populated by the combat module (RFC-0007). Distinct from the legacy flat `health` field until combat migrates to it.

defense.description: Derived: 40 + (body x 3) + armor_bonus. The d100 target an attacker must beat. Populated by the combat module (RFC-0007).

magic_pool.description: Derived: max = will x 2. Spent per spell by the magic module (RFC-0008). Only meaningful for casters.
